title: fast reopen mitigation: exponential cooldown + jitter stabilizer for circuit state
author: Anya Patel
description: Fix for rapid circuit flapping observed in multi-tenant regional nodes where circuits would reopen too aggressively after transient errors, causing oscillations and wasted capacity. This PR introduces an exponential cooldown with randomized jitter applied at the circuit-controller level, per-tenant and per-region backoff state persisted to the local KV store, and a feature flag to enable gradual rollout. It contains telemetry to surface reopening frequency, cooldown distribution, and tenant impact breakdown. Includes migration to add a compact cooldown snapshot to the circuit-state protobuf for faster reads, unit and integration tests, and canonical config defaults. Motivation: root cause traced to dual timers (local timer + global reconcilier) racing on reopen which produced sub-millisecond reopen windows under load; the exponential cooldown prevents rapid reopen cycles while allowing eventual recovery. Rollout plan: start with 10% of traffic in us-west with canary gate in the control plane, evaluate alerts for 48h, then widen to 50% and full rollout. This PR was driven by incident INC-2026-02-18 and linked to ENG-4217.
commits: fix(core/circuit): add exponentialCooldownMs and jitterPct to CircuitState and controller
feat(kv): persist cooldown snapshot to tenant-local KV with compact encoding
test(circuit): add unit tests for cooldown decay and reopen thresholds
chore(config): expose feature flag rfd.cooldown_stabilizer and default config
ci: add integration scenario to perf-canary pipeline
files_changed: core/circuit/controller.go - main cooldown loop and state machine adjustments
config/defaults.yaml - rfd.cooldown_stabilizer: enabled=false, initial_window_ms=250, multiplier=2.0, max_backoff_ms=120000, jitter=0.15
tests/circuit/cooldown_test.go - unit tests simulating races and gradual decay
ci/pipelines/perf-canary.yaml - new scenario to validate reopen stability under synthetic transient errors
review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Please add a short note in the circuit docs about persisted cooldown semantics so ops know how to interpret lastReopenTs. Actioned in docs commit.
Sofia Chen: The exponential multiplier is 2.0 by default; consider 1.5 for very bursty tenants to avoid long stalls. Reply: added config knob multiplier and canary target to tune post-rollout.

Eliot Barnes: Concerned about KV write amplification when persisting cooldown per reopen. Reply: cooldown snapshot is compacted and only written on state transitions exceeding the previous cooldown window to reduce writes; added instrumentation to measure write rate.
QA Bot: Added test scenario where global reconciler delay and local timer both fire; regression prevented.
release_notes: Introduce exponential cooldown stabilizer for circuit reopen to prevent rapid reopen flapping; feature gated and off by default; metrics and canary pipeline added.
